<!-- pr-reviewer: 6716fad19583a9a8cfafe45826058a8e2754ef3b -->
**Ready for the maintainer to merge** (a `feat`: merges at the next cut).

**What looks good**
- One pick rule held (#692): candidates are feature chains / welded faces only (`box_pick.rs` `is_feature_chain`, `f.sel`), never facet seams; each needs an unoccluded sample via the click pick's own `occluded` (visibility-only change in `feature_pick.rs`); pick-through is not offered (`through: false`); stock and fixtures never candidates but still occlude.
- Rule is exact and documented: window = every segment end wholly inside, crossing = Liang-Barsky clip / triangle-touch; drag right = window, left = crossing; stated in the decision file, hover text and rubber-band style (solid vs dashed). Degenerate/non-finite box or zero view dir returns nothing, no panics or unwraps in non-test code.
- One `SetOperationGeometry` per box (one undo); the rubber band (`state.pick_box`) is view state, not in history. MCP twin `pick_in_box` ships in the same PR, reuses `kind_door`, refuses empty / no-area / already-picked boxes by name.
- No snapshot PNGs, no process files, no deps/build.rs/.github; structural-style kittest drives real pointer events; provenance lines present; decision file added; body has `Changelog:` and `Fixes #979`.
- Not one of the SolidCraft UI hold items (#655/#658/#659/#661).

**Local results** (merged with upstream/main: already up to date, no conflicts)
| check | result |
|---|---|
| `camcraft-app` test box_pick | 6 passed |
| feature_pick | 7 passed |
| mcp_pick | 4 passed |
| `camcraft-ui --lib` (cwd crates/ui, `--test-threads=1`, incl. both `box_select` tests) | 533 passed, 5 ignored |
| `cargo clippy -p camcraft-app -p camcraft-ui --all-targets -- -D warnings` | clean |

**Requested before merge:** none.

**Notes (not blocking)**
1. The viewport path (`crates/ui/src/box_pick.rs` `finish`) does not run the MCP `kind_door` check, so a Face/Edge box on a MultiAxisContour op can queue non-chain picks. This matches the existing click path (`interact.rs:241`, `edge_pick.rs`), and generation refuses by name, but a follow-up could share the door with the UI.
2. Perspective "visible" includes what the eye sees down a through-cutout (pinned in test and decision file); worth a maintainer glance since a box can then take cutout wall rims a Top-view user may not expect.
3. Cost is up to 16 sight rays x every facet per candidate; untimed on a very large mesh (as the body says).
4. `shell.rs` is 983 lines (already over 400; this PR adds ~25). The camcraft-mcp skill table has no `pick_in_box` row (process file; fine deferred).

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.

<!-- pr-reviewer: af37622c974a212d245a7f0528183d7fece03bb5 -->
**Needs changes before merge** (one blocker: the box ignores the Pick through toggle).

**What looks good**
- Window and crossing are stated (drag right = window, left = crossing) and both are tested, in app (`crates/app/tests/box_pick.rs`) and in the UI (`egui_app/tests/box_select.rs`).
- The hit-testing lives in app (`pick/box_pick.rs`). Only feature chains and welded faces are candidates, never tessellation edges. Occlusion uses the click pick's own `occluded`. Stock and fixtures hide things but are never picked.
- One `SetOperationGeometry` per box, so one undo removes the whole box. The rubber band is ephemeral `State::pick_box`, not a command.
- `pick_in_box` validates NaN/inf, zero-area boxes and bad mode/kind/replace with plain errors. It runs the same `SetOperationGeometry`, and the tool is in the table. No `unwrap`/`expect`/`panic!` in the new code. The new files are 133 to 283 lines. No snapshot PNGs changed. The `Changelog:` and `Fixes #979` lines are present.
- The test for a known model asserts the exact rim chains for a plate with cutouts, not just "non-empty" (`a_window_around_one_cutout_takes_exactly_its_top_rim`).

**Local results (merged cleanly with current origin/main, including #1204 and #1203)**
- `camcraft-app --lib`: 147 passed.
- app `--test box_pick`: 6 passed. `feature_pick`: 7. `mcp_pick`: 6. `mcp`: 18.
- `camcraft-ui --lib` (CWD `crates/ui`): 618 passed, 5 ignored (includes `box_select`, `pick_through`). ui `--test boundary_picks`: 6 passed.
- `cargo clippy -p camcraft-app -p camcraft-ui --all-targets -D warnings`: clean.

**Requested before merge**
1. `crates/ui/src/box_pick.rs:~76` hard-codes `through: false` ("pick-through is not offered"). Main now has the Pick through toggle (`state.pick_through`, PR #1204), and `feature_click.rs:125` passes it to the click pick. The box must read it too, or a click and a box disagree about hidden features: `through: state.pick_through`. Update the stale comment there and the decision note (`docs/decisions/979-box-select-picks.md:24`, "Pick-through stays off"). Add a UI test of the box both ways: toggle off leaves the hidden rims out, toggle on takes them. The app test already covers `through: true` (`box_pick.rs:131`); the UI path is the untested part.
2. The MCP `pick_in_box` is always occluded, with no `through` argument. Either add an optional boolean `through` (default false) or say in the tool description and decision note that headless boxes are always visible-only. A named choice is enough.
3. There is no `camcraft-mcp` skill row for `pick_in_box` (`.claude/skills/camcraft-mcp/SKILL.md` is untouched). Add the row. That is a process file, so also bump `.claude/PROCESS_VERSION`. Alternatively file a `source:agent` `P5` follow-up and name it in the body.

**Notes (not blocking)**
- `crates/ui/src/box_pick.rs:30` and `interact.rs` read `mods.ctrl || mods.shift` (raw Ctrl). This matches today's click toggle. If PR #1242 moves the add-to-selection key to the platform command modifier, `armed()` needs the same change. The hint and status text say "Ctrl".
- `shell.rs` (992 lines) and `state.rs` (4363) were already far over 400. This PR adds 27 and 4 lines. Growth is flagged, not blocking.
- `mcp/mod.rs` puts the `mod box_pick;` line after `mod pick;` with a comment line between. Cosmetic.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.

<!-- pr-reviewer: ab27715e34beee3dde33fbc556852fd3e73bf38c -->
**Needs changes before merge** (re-review at `ab27715e`: the command-modifier note is fixed; the three earlier requests are still open).

**What changed since `af37622c`** (verified from the code; the rest of the delta is merges of main)
- `crates/ui/src/box_pick.rs:28` now reads `mods.command || mods.shift` instead of raw Ctrl. That follows #1242's click toggle. The box_select test was updated to match.

**Requested before merge (unchanged, still open)**
1. `crates/ui/src/box_pick.rs:74` still has `through: false, // pick-through is not offered`. A box ignores main's `state.pick_through` toggle, while a click reads it (`feature_click.rs:125`). Use `through: state.pick_through`. Fix that comment and `docs/decisions/979-box-select-picks.md:24` ("Pick-through stays off"). Add a UI test of the box with the toggle off (hidden rims left out) and on (taken).
2. The MCP `pick_in_box` still has no `through` argument. Add an optional boolean (default false), or state in the tool description and decision note that headless boxes are visible-only.
3. There is still no `pick_in_box` row in `.claude/skills/camcraft-mcp/SKILL.md` (0 mentions), and `.claude/PROCESS_VERSION` is untouched by this PR (main is at 32, so a PR that adds the row must end at 33). The PR body still says the skill table is deliberately not updated, and it names no follow-up issue. Add the row with the bump, or name a `source:agent` `P5` follow-up in the body.

**Notes (not blocking)**
- The hint, status text and `Changelog:` line still say "Ctrl". On macOS the modifier is now Cmd, so "Ctrl/Cmd" (or "the command key") would read correctly.
- `shell.rs` and `state.rs` were already over 400 lines and grow slightly (+31 and +4 lines).

**Local results** (head trial-merged cleanly with `origin/main` `235982b3`)
- app `--test box_pick`: 6 passed. `feature_pick`: 7. `mcp_pick`: 6. `mcp`: 18.
- `camcraft-ui --lib` (CWD `crates/ui`): 618 passed, 5 ignored. ui `--test boundary_picks`: 6 passed.
- `cargo clippy -p camcraft-app -p camcraft-ui --all-targets -D warnings`: clean.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.
